# EA HTSMS

> HTSMS is a proprietary subscription SaaS that turns a customer-owned Android phone and SIM card into a tenant-isolated, programmable SMS gateway. Pair a device, issue scoped API keys, send transactional messages from a clean REST API, and track every delivery from a secure workspace.

## About

- Product: programmable SMS gateway built on customer-owned Android phones and SIM cards.
- Audience: businesses in Cameroon and beyond that need transactional SMS.
- Key capabilities: device pairing, scoped developer API keys, inbound and outbound messaging, signed webhooks, per-workspace isolation.
- Languages: English and French.
